```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM inventories i
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),
explode AS (
    -- parts directly in set 80033-1's current inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num = '80033-1' AND ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- nested sets
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- minifigs
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explode
WHERE part_num = '15504';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
target AS (
    SELECT id FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '21123-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
),
explode AS (
    -- parts directly in the set's current inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN target t ON ip.inventory_id = t.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- parts inside nested sets
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- parts inside minifigs
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explode e
JOIN colors c ON e.color_id = c.id
WHERE e.part_num = '3024'
  AND c.name = 'Light Bluish Gray';
```

```sql
root_inv AS (
    SELECT id FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '5004718-1'
      AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '5004718-1')
),

explode AS (
    -- parts directly in root inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num AS item, 'part' AS kind, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN root_inv r ON ip.inventory_id = r.id

    SELECT ins.set_num, 'set', ins.quantity
    FROM inventory_sets ins
    JOIN root_inv r ON ins.inventory_id = r.id

    -- minifigs in root inventory
    SELECT im.fig_num, 'minifig', im.quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN root_inv r ON im.inventory_id = r.id

    -- expand nested sets (current inventory)
    SELECT ip.part_num, 'part', ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = e.item
```

```sql
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i3.id
```

```sql
    WHERE set_num = '41319-1'
      AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '41319-1')

    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN root_inv r ON im.inventory_id = r.id
    UNION ALL
    -- expand nested sets (current inventory)

    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = e.item
```

```sql
-- current inventory of the asked set
root_inv AS (
    SELECT id FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '42677-1'
      AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '42677-1')
),
-- recursive explosion: track item type (part / set / minifig)
explode AS (
    -- parts directly in the root inventory (including spares)
    SELECT 'part' AS kind, ip.part_num AS item, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN root_inv r ON ip.inventory_id = r.id
    UNION ALL
    -- nested sets in the root inventory
    SELECT 'set', ins.set_num, ins.quantity
    FROM inventory_sets ins
    JOIN root_inv r ON ins.inventory_id = r.id
    UNION ALL
    -- minifigs in the root inventory
    SELECT 'minifig', im.fig_num, im.quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN root_inv r ON im.inventory_id = r.id
    UNION ALL
    -- expand nested sets (current inventory)
    SELECT 'part', ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = e.item
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE e.kind = 'set'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'set', ins.set_num, ins.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = e.item
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item)
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = i2.id

    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = e.item
```

```sql
    WHERE set_num = '21267-1'

explode AS (
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
target_color AS (
    SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Black'
),
-- current inventory for every set
set_inv AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num)
),
-- current inventory for every minifig
fig_inv AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num AS fig_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num)
),
-- explode contents of a set inventory: returns part_num, color_id, qty
explode AS (
    -- direct parts of the set's own inventory
    SELECT si.set_num AS root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_inv si
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = si.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- nested sets
    SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN set_inv si2 ON si2.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = si2.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- minifigs
    SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN fig_inv fi ON fi.fig_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = fi.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num)
FROM sets s
JOIN explode e ON e.root_set = s.set_num
JOIN target_color tc ON e.color_id = tc.id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- current inventory (highest version) for every set/fig
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn
    FROM inventories
),
-- the specific inventory: version 1 of set 8043-1
root_inv AS (
    SELECT id FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '8043-1' AND version = 1
),
-- recursive expansion: (inventory_id, multiplier)
explode AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id, 1 AS multiplier
    FROM root_inv
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN ci.id ELSE ci_fig.id END,
        e.multiplier * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity)
    FROM explode e
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num AND ci.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN current_inv ci_fig ON ci_fig.set_num = im.fig_num AND ci_fig.rn = 1
    WHERE iset.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.multiplier * ip.quantity), 0) AS total_parts
FROM explode e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE ip.is_spare = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
),
version1_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '8486-1' AND version = 1
),
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        '8486-1' as current_item,
        1 as multiplier,
        0 as depth
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(iset.set_num, im.fig_num) as current_item,
        ap.multiplier * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity) as multiplier,
        ap.depth + 1
    FROM all_parts ap
    JOIN version1_inventory vi ON vi.set_num = ap.current_item
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = vi.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = vi.id
    WHERE iset.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
),
item_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.current_item,
        ap.multiplier,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ap.multiplier * ip.quantity as total_qty
    FROM all_parts ap
    JOIN version1_inventory vi ON vi.set_num = ap.current_item
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = vi.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_parts
FROM item_parts
```

```sql
    WHERE set_num = '71837-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

-- explode: (part_num, color_id, qty, from_direct)

    -- direct parts of the set's own inventory

    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN target t ON ip.inventory_id = t.inv_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- nested sets
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty, false
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
),
version1_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '66638-1' AND version = 1
),
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        '66638-1' as current_item,
        1 as multiplier,
        0 as depth
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(iset.set_num, im.fig_num) as current_item,
        ap.multiplier * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity) as multiplier,
        ap.depth + 1
    FROM all_parts ap
    LEFT JOIN version1_inventory vi ON vi.set_num = ap.current_item
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ap.current_item AND ci.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = COALESCE(vi.id, ci.id)
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = COALESCE(vi.id, ci.id)
    WHERE iset.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
),
item_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.current_item,
        ap.multiplier,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

    FROM all_parts ap
    LEFT JOIN version1_inventory vi ON vi.set_num = ap.current_item
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ap.current_item AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = COALESCE(vi.id, ci.id)
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
```

```sql
    SELECT i.id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),
explode AS (
```
```sql
    -- Base: parts directly in set 71746-1
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE i.set_num = '71746-1'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '71746-1')
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantity and recurse
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inv ci2 ON ci2.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num

    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (

    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)

    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id

      AND ip.is_spare = false

    FROM explode e
```
```sql
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
```
```sql
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num

    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num AS root
    FROM inventories
    WHERE (set_num, version) IN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version)
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    )
),
explode AS (
    -- Parts directly in the set's inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.root = '66448-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from nested sets (current inventory)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.root = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs (current inventory)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.root = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_parts FROM explode;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
explode AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from the set's current inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE i.set_num = '43208-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantity and recurse
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: multiply quantity and recurse (minifig parts)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty

    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num

    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (part_num, color_id)) AS distinct_part_color_combinations
FROM explode;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE exploded(parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty) AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
      AND parent_num = '60441-1'
      AND version = 1
      AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, e.qty * u.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON e.child_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND e.child_num = u.parent_num
     AND u.version = (
         SELECT MAX(version)
         FROM u_composition u2
         WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind
           AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
     )
     AND u.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT SUM(qty)
FROM exploded
WHERE child_kind = 'minifig';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
explode AS (
    -- Start with the set's current inventory parts
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE i.set_num = '4436-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets' parts (current inventory)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs' parts (current inventory)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (part_num, color_id)) AS distinct_part_color_combinations
FROM explode;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
```
```sql
explode AS (
```
```sql
    -- Base: parts directly in the set's current inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    WHERE i.set_num = '43205-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantities
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i ON ins.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i1.set_num)
),
explode AS (
    -- Base: parts directly in the set's current inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE i.set_num = '21360-1'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '21360-1')
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantities
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: multiply quantities
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_parts
FROM explode e
JOIN parts p ON e.part_num = p.part_num
JOIN part_categories pc ON p.part_cat_id = pc.id
WHERE pc.name = 'Minifig Upper Body';
```

```sql
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
explode(set_num, part_num, qty, level) AS (
    -- Base: parts directly in the set's current inventory

        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity,
        0
    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = i.set_num AND ci.version = i.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE s.set_num = '5003484-1'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: expand to their parts
    SELECT 
        e.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * ins.quantity,
        e.level + 1
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = (
        SELECT i.id 
        FROM inventories i
        JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = i.set_num AND ci.version = i.version
        WHERE i.set_num = e.part_num
    )

    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * im.quantity,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '21317-1' AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '21317-1')
),
explode AS (
    -- Parts directly in the set's inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    UNION ALL
    -- Parts from nested sets (current inventory)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM current_inv)
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE e.part_num = ins.set_num
    UNION ALL
    -- Parts from minifigs
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * im.quantity
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    -- Need to include this in recursive structure properly
),
-- Reconstructing with proper recursion for nested sets and minifigs
base_items AS (
    -- Direct parts
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty, 1 AS level
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    UNION ALL
    -- Minifigs: expand to their parts
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * im.quantity AS qty, 2 AS level
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN inventories i_minifig ON i_minifig.set_num = im.fig_num
        AND i_minifig.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i_minifig.id
    UNION ALL
    -- Nested sets: need recursive expansion
    SELECT ins.set_num AS part_num, NULL::INT AS color_id, ins.quantity AS qty, 2 AS level
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
),
recursive_explode AS (
    -- Base: all parts and nested sets at top level
    SELECT bi.part_num, bi.color_id, bi.qty
    FROM base_items bi
    WHERE bi.level = 1 OR (bi.level = 2 AND bi.color_id IS NOT NULL)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * re.qty
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = re.part_num
        AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = re.part_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE re.color_id IS NULL  -- it's a nested set, not a part
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand minifigs within nested sets
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity * im.quantity * re.qty
    FROM recursive_explode re
```

```sql
    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),

    SELECT 
        i.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM exploded_contents e

    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON i2.set_num = ci2.set_num AND i2.version = ci2.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    -- Minifigs: multiply quantity and recurse

)
```

```sql
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
```

```sql
    -- Nested sets: expand sets within sets

        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM exploded_parts e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories

    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE subthemes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Super Heroes DC'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id
    FROM themes c
    JOIN subthemes p ON c.parent_id = p.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN themes t ON s.theme_id = t.id
    WHERE t.name = 'Super Heroes DC'
       OR t.id IN (SELECT id FROM subthemes)
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) m ON i.set_num = m.set_num AND i.version = m.max_version
),
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base: parts directly in set inventory
    SELECT ci.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND ci.set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT ep.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * ep.qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ep.part_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: minifigs (minifig inventory)
    SELECT ep.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * ep.qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = ep.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT set_num) AS num_sets
FROM exploded_parts
```

```sql
    -- Direct containment: inventory has the minifig

    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN containing_sets cs ON cs.set_num = ins.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
)
SELECT DISTINCT set_num
FROM containing_sets
WHERE set_num LIKE '%-%'  -- Ensure it's a set (not a minifig, though minifigs don't have fig_num pattern matching sets)
ORDER BY set_num;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
exploded_sets AS (
    -- Start with sets that have the part directly in their current inventory
    SELECT DISTINCT i.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand nested sets
    SELECT i.set_num, e.part_num, e.qty * ins.quantity
    FROM exploded_sets e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.set_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND ip.part_num = e.part_num
),
-- Also need to handle minifigs: minifigs have their own inventory of parts
exploded_minifigs AS (
    -- Parts directly in set inventory
    SELECT DISTINCT i.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: a minifig's inventory contains parts
    SELECT i.set_num, ip2.part_num, im.quantity * ip2.quantity
    FROM exploded_minifigs e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = e.set_num 
        AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.set_num)
    )
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN current_inv ci2 ON i2.set_num = ci2.set_num AND i2.version = ci2.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip2 ON ip2.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip2.is_spare = false
      AND ip2.part_num = e.part_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets (which may contain minifigs with parts)
    SELECT i.set_num, e.part_num, e.qty * ins.quantity
    FROM exploded_minifigs e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.set_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND ip.part_num = e.part_num
),
-- Combine both paths: direct parts, nested sets, and minifigs
all_parts AS (
    SELECT set_num, part_num, qty FROM exploded_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT set_num, part_num, qty FROM exploded_minifigs
),
-- Proper recursive CTE to explode all contents
recursive_explode AS (
    -- Base: all parts directly in a set's current inventory
    SELECT i.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty, 1 AS level
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets (their current inventory)
    SELECT re.set_num, ip.part_num, re.qty * ins.quantity, re.level + 1
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = re.set_num 
        AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = re.set_num)

    JOIN current_inv ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE subthemes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Star Wars'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id
    FROM themes c
    JOIN subthemes p ON c.parent_id = p.id
),
star_wars_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM subthemes)
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts in current inventory of Star Wars sets
    SELECT 
        s.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM star_wars_sets s
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantities and continue recursion
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM exploded_contents e
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: expand to their parts
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM exploded_contents e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set) AS num_sets
FROM exploded_contents
WHERE part_num = '3003' AND color_id = 15;
```

```sql
        'set' AS item_type,
        1 AS quantity
    FROM sets s
    
    UNION ALL

        e.root_set,
        ins.set_num AS current_item,
        'set' AS item_type,
        e.quantity * ins.quantity AS quantity

    JOIN current_inv ci ON e.current_item = ci.set_num

    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),

    UNION ALL
    SELECT root_set, current_item, item_type, quantity FROM exploded_minifigs
),

minifig_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ae.root_set
    FROM all_exploded ae
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ae.current_item = ci.set_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ae.current_item AND i.version = ci.max_version
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE target_color AS (
    SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'White'
),
target_part AS (
    SELECT '39793' AS part_num
),
-- Find all inventories that contain the target part in target color (directly)
direct_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.set_num
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    CROSS JOIN target_color tc
    CROSS JOIN target_part tp
    WHERE ip.part_num = tp.part_num
      AND ip.color_id = tc.id
      AND ip.is_spare = false
),
-- Recursive explosion: find all sets whose current inventory contains nested sets/minifigs that lead to the target part
-- We need to find all paths from sets down to the target part
-- First, get current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT set_num, id AS inventory_id, version
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Recursive: explode sets to find what they contain (parts, nested sets, minifigs)
-- We track the path and quantities
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts in current inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        ip.is_spare,
        FALSE AS is_nested_set,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS nested_set_num
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: nested sets in current inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS part_num,
        NULL::INT AS color_id,
        ins.quantity AS qty,
        FALSE AS is_spare,
        TRUE AS is_nested_set,
```

```sql
),
sets_2018 AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2018
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),
explode AS (
    -- Base: direct parts in current inventory of 2018 sets
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    CROSS JOIN sets_2018 s18
    WHERE ci.set_num = s18.set_num
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantity and recurse
    SELECT 
        e.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    -- Minifigs: multiply quantity and recurse
    SELECT 
        e.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.set_num) AS num_sets
FROM explode e
```

```sql
    SELECT DISTINCT i.set_num
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    CROSS JOIN target_color tc
    CROSS JOIN target_part tp
    WHERE ip.part_num = tp.part_num
      AND ip.color_id = tc.id
      AND ip.is_spare = false
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)

    -- Base: sets that directly contain the target part/color in their current inventory
    SELECT di.set_num, 1 AS level
    FROM direct_inventories di
    WHERE di.set_num LIKE '%-%'  -- sets have dash in set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include minifigs that contain the target part/color (they can be nested in sets)
    SELECT DISTINCT i.set_num, 1 AS level
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inventories i ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    CROSS JOIN target_color tc
    CROSS JOIN target_part tp
    WHERE ip.part_num = tp.part_num
      AND ip.color_id = tc.id
      AND ip.is_spare = false
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
      AND i.set_num NOT LIKE '%-%'  -- minifigs don't have dash
    
    UNION ALL
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get current inventory version for each set/fig
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
),
version1_set_inventory AS (
    -- Version 1 inventory for set 8486-1
    SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '8486-1'
      AND i.version = 1
),
all_items AS (
    -- Start with set 8486-1 at version 1, multiplier 1
    SELECT 
        '8486-1' as current_item,
        1 as multiplier,
        0 as depth,
        true as is_version1_root  -- flag to track if we're in the root set's version 1 inventory
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets and minifigs from current inventory
    -- For root set, use version 1; for all others, use current (highest version)
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(iset.set_num, im.fig_num) as current_item,
        ai.multiplier * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity) as multiplier,
        ai.depth + 1,
        false as is_version1_root
    FROM all_items ai
    JOIN (
        -- Use version 1 for root, current for others
        SELECT id, set_num, version
        FROM inventories
        WHERE set_num = '8486-1' AND version = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id, set_num, version
        FROM current_inventory
        WHERE rn = 1 AND set_num != '8486-1'
    ) inv ON inv.set_num = ai.current_item
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = inv.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = inv.id
    WHERE iset.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
),
item_parts AS (
    -- Get all parts from all expanded items
    SELECT 
        ai.current_item,
        ai.multiplier,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ai.multiplier * ip.quantity as total_qty
    FROM all_items ai
    JOIN (
        -- Use version 1 for root, current for others
        SELECT id, set_num, version
        FROM inventories
        WHERE set_num = '8486-1' AND version = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id, set_num, version
        FROM current_inventory
        WHERE rn = 1 AND set_num != '8486-1'
    ) inv ON inv.set_num = ai.current_item
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_parts
FROM item_parts;
```

```sql
    WHERE name = 'Racers'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id
    FROM themes c
    JOIN racers_themes p ON c.parent_id = p.id

    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    JOIN racers_themes rt ON s.theme_id = rt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2012
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = s.set_num)
),
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from each set's inventory
    SELECT si.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_inventories si
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = si.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantities and recurse
    SELECT ep.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * ep.qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = ep.part_num
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ins.set_num
        AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: multiply quantities and recurse
    SELECT ep.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.quantity * ep.qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep

    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num

    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id

    FROM exploded_parts
    GROUP BY set_num
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Duplo'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT th.id
    FROM themes th
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON th.parent_id = tt.id
),
set_parts AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, s.num_parts AS catalog_parts
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2022
),
exploded(set_num, parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty) AS (
    -- Start with current inventory of each set
    SELECT sp.set_num, u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, u.qty
    FROM set_parts sp
    JOIN u_composition u ON u.parent_kind = 'set' AND u.parent_num = sp.set_num
    WHERE u.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM u_composition u2
        WHERE u2.parent_kind = 'set' AND u2.parent_num = sp.set_num
    )
    AND u.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets and minifigs using their current inventory
    SELECT e.set_num, u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, e.qty * u.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON e.child_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND e.child_num = u.parent_num
    WHERE u.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM u_composition u2
        WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
    )
    AND u.is_spare = FALSE
),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all themes under 'Super Heroes DC' (including itself)
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Super Heroes DC'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT th.id
    FROM themes th
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON th.parent_id = tt.id
),
-- Get all sets in those themes
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
-- Explode all target sets to find which contain fig-003310 at any level
sets_with_fig AS (
    -- Start with current inventory of target sets
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
      AND parent_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
      AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM u_composition u2 WHERE u2.parent_kind = 'set' AND u2.parent_num = u_composition.parent_num)
      AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, e.qty * u.qty
    FROM sets_with_fig e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON e.child_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND e.child_num = u.parent_num
     AND u.version = (
         SELECT MAX(version)
         FROM u_composition u2
         WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind
           AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
     )
     AND u.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Get distinct sets that contain the minifig
fig_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_num AS set_num
    FROM sets_with_fig
    WHERE child_kind = 'minifig' AND child_num = 'fig-003310'
),
-- Explode all target sets to find which contain part 88646 at any level
sets_with_part AS (
    -- Start with current inventory of target sets
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty, color_id
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
      AND parent_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
      AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM u_composition u2 WHERE u2.parent_kind = 'set' AND u2.parent_num = u_composition.parent_num)
      AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, e.qty * u.qty, u.color_id
    FROM sets_with_part e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON e.child_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND e.child_num = u.parent_num
     AND u.version = (
         SELECT MAX(version)
         FROM u_composition u2
         WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind
           AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
     )
     AND u.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Get distinct sets that contain the part (any colour)
part_sets AS (

    FROM sets_with_part
    WHERE child_kind = 'part' AND child_num = '88646'
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM fig_sets f
JOIN part_sets p ON f.set_num = p.set_num;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE exploded(parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, color_id, qty) AS (
    -- Start with current inventory of set BAM2020-1
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, color_id, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
      AND parent_num = 'BAM2020-1'
      AND version = (
          SELECT MAX(version)
          FROM u_composition
          WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
            AND parent_num = 'BAM2020-1'
      )
      AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets and minifigs using their current inventory
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, u.color_id, e.qty * u.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON e.child_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND e.child_num = u.parent_num
     AND u.version = (
         SELECT MAX(version)
         FROM u_composition u2
         WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind
           AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
     )
     AND u.is_spare = FALSE
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '41319-1' AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '41319-1')
),
explode AS (
    -- Direct parts from the set's inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    UNION ALL
    -- Parts from minifigs
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, im.quantity * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num AND mi.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mi.id
    UNION ALL
    -- Parts from nested sets (recursive)
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ins.quantity * e.qty AS qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_parts FROM explode;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE theme_hierarchy AS (
    -- Find the 'Advent' theme
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Advent'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively find all sub-themes
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num) AS num_sets
FROM sets s
JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
WHERE s.year = 2018;
```
